title: Gemini MLLM Voice Agent for Go
tagline: Build an end-to-end Gemini 3.8 Live MLLM voice agent with Go and Agora.
description: Create a browser voice AI app backed by Go and Gin, where Gemini 3.8 Live handles speech understanding and generation end to end and Agora provides real-time RTC and RTM communication.
author: Agora
